question_text: Did the keynote stage attendance drop off later in the day, or stay similar across the morning and afternoon keynotes?

citations.cypher:
WITH '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AS W_start, '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AS W_end
CALL {
  WITH W_start, W_end
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= W_start AND ch.hour_utc < W_end
    AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'keynote'
  WITH ch, CASE WHEN toInteger(substring(ch.hour_utc, 11, 2)) < 12 THEN 'morning' ELSE 'afternoon' END AS period
  RETURN 'hourly' AS grain, ch.camera_location AS camera_location, period, ch.hour_utc AS hour, ch.avg_hc AS avg_hc, ch.peak_hc AS peak_hc, ch.event_count AS samples
  UNION ALL
  WITH W_start, W_end
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= W_start AND ch.hour_utc < W_end
    AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'keynote'
  WITH ch, CASE WHEN toInteger(substring(ch.hour_utc, 11, 2)) < 12 THEN 'morning' ELSE 'afternoon' END AS period
  WITH ch.camera_location AS camera_location, period, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS wsum, sum(ch.event_count) AS samples, max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
  RETURN 'period_camera' AS grain, camera_location, period, null AS hour, (wsum / samples) AS avg_hc, peak_hc AS peak_hc, samples
  UNION ALL
  WITH W_start, W_end
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= W_start AND ch.hour_utc < W_end
    AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'keynote'
  WITH ch, CASE WHEN toInteger(substring(ch.hour_utc, 11, 2)) < 12 THEN 'morning' ELSE 'afternoon' END AS period
  WITH period, sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS wsum, sum(ch.event_count) AS samples, max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc
  RETURN 'period_overall' AS grain, 'ALL_KEYNOTE' AS camera_location, period, null AS hour, (wsum / samples) AS avg_hc, peak_hc AS peak_hc, samples
}
RETURN grain, camera_location, period, hour, avg_hc, peak_hc, samples
ORDER BY CASE grain WHEN 'period_overall' THEN 0 WHEN 'period_camera' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, camera_location, period, hour
